canh.prompt: In a medium shot, Hân Hân gently moves a blue marker to trace river lines on a large world map, while Nhật Minh holds a magnifying glass over the map, subtly shifting his head and blinking as he studies the details. In the background, dust motes slowly drift in soft library sunlight. The camera performs a very slow, subtle push-in toward the students.

A slow, gentle push-in camera captures Nhật Minh and Hân Hân in orange polo shirts standing on the dirt dike, turning their heads slightly and gesturing toward the expansive river valley below. In the background, river water ripples and glitters under soft sunlight. Ancient villagers move naturally: a farmer guides an ox plowing a muddy field, a woman shuttles a loom inside a thatched hut, and another person shapes wet clay on a pottery wheel by the riverbank.

A slow timelapse pan moves across the riverbank as humble thatched huts rapidly transform into bustling brick houses. In the background, villagers busily plow fields, shape pottery on spinning wheels, weave fabric on wooden looms, and row cargo boats along the flowing river. In the foreground, Nhật Minh and Hân Hân stand side by side in orange polo shirts, calmly observing the changing landscape; Hân Hân gestures gently with an open hand, while Nhật Minh nods with natural head movements.

A slow push-in camera moves toward a bustling ancient Sumerian city street framed by mud-brick walls. In the foreground, a Sumerian man wearing a traditional wrapped skirt and holding a clay jar excitedly gestures forward with his free hand while speaking naturally. In the background, townsfolk walk briskly along the dusty pathways, children chase each other playfully, and faint smoke drifts lazily from the tops of nearby houses under bright daylight.

A slow push-in camera captures the vibrant ancient river city. In the foreground, Hân Hân and Nhật Minh in orange polo shirts stand on a flat brick roof, observing the bustling streets below. Nhật Minh gestures calmly toward the grid-like city layout while speaking with natural lip movement. Hân Hân turns her head to listen, nodding gently and smiling. In the background, tiny citizens walk along the straight, orderly brick streets under a clear sky.

A slow, melancholic push-in captures the deserted ancient streets bathed in soft evening light. Dust motes drift lazily through the warm air past crumbling brick walls. In the midground, a few weary residents slowly lead their livestock along the dusty riverbank. In the foreground, student narrators Hân Hân and Nhật Minh, wearing orange polo shirts, turn their heads slightly with gentle, somber expressions, their lips moving naturally in quiet conversation.

A slow push-in camera focuses on two 15-year-old students in orange polo shirts standing on either side of a large library map with three highlighted rivers. Hân Hân gently turns her head to look directly at the viewer, her lips moving naturally as if speaking to the audience. Nhật Minh stands beside her, smiling warmly and gesturing slightly toward the map with an open palm. Dust motes drift softly in the warm library background light.
